It now passes `shared.nullarray[c->resp]` (`*-1` / `_*` for RESP2/RESP3) when a count is present, matching the documented behavior.

- Raw protocol check: `LPOP NONEXISTINGLIST 10` → `*-1\r\n`, `RPOP NONEXISTINGLIST 5` → `*-1\r\n`, `LPOP NONEXISTINGLIST` → `$-1\r\n`
